diagnosis.what_happened: academic-writer generated robotic, templated narrations for tables using fill-in-the-blank structures.
diagnosis.behavior_caused_outcome: Mechanical loop boilerplates led to repetitive sentence structures that violated the standard for authentic, high-quality Persian academic prose.
diagnosis.what_should_have_happened: The agent should have composed dynamic, authentic Persian academic prose with natural syntactic and lexical variation tailored to each specific table.
diagnosis.rationale_why: Scholarly writing requires both factual objectivity and natural syntactic variation to maintain reader engagement and meet academic standards, avoiding the impression of automated text generation.

desired_behavior: Compose dynamic, authentic Persian academic prose with natural syntactic and lexical variation tailored to each specific table, completely banning cookie-cutter fill-in-the-blank templates and mechanical loop boilerplates, while preserving strict factual objectivity without speculative interpretation.
generalization: Academic narration of statistical results must employ natural syntactic and lexical variation without resorting to mechanical templates.

evidence.observed_value: Repetitive mechanical phrasing found in table narration
